easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature with power less than or equal to the creature you intend to donate.
Lure attached to Sentinel.
Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Spawnbroker by paying {2}{U}.
When Spawnbroker enters, it triggers, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls with equal or lesser power and Altanak.
During your next declare attackers step, declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
